newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans rally on commission house buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans rally on commission house buying.

text.p: Commission house buying in July soybean futures pushed that contract sharply higher in fast trading near the market's open, traders said.
"Chicago Corp bought three to four million (bushels), and they want more," a floor trader said.
Some of the buying in July was said to come from the options pit, traders said.
Refco bought one million July, Cargill Inventors Services bought 500,000 July, floor sources said.
Soybean registrations dropped to a scant 20,000 bushels Wednesday and generated supply concerns, traders said.
At 0949 CDT, July soybeans were 13 cents per bushel higher at $8.43-1/2. Other months were 1-1/2 to 7-1/4 cents higher.
